title.narrative: CTF Carbon Trust Fund ACCTIF (Article 6 Climate Cooperation Fund)

description.narrative: MATS Program (GIS04) is terminated as of 31 October 2024 and its activities will continue starting on 1 November 2024 under the Swedish Carbon Trust Fund (Article 6 Climate Cooperation Fund - ACCTIF). ACCTIF was established through theDecision Memo5584. Remaining fund under the MATS Program will be transferred to this newly established ACCTIF fund. In addition to the MATS Termination Agreement (signed on 15 October 2024), a separate agreement with SEA will be signed in the form of an Amended Contribution Agreement No.1 to the ACCTIF Fund to move the funding balance into the Fund. This amendment to ACCTIF is expected to be signed in November 2024.Click here to see: MATSTermination AgreementNew project codes will be activated on 1 November under the ACCTIF (T2402CP-T1; CTFT001-E1, E2, etc.) for budgeting and reporting of continued activities under the Carbon Trust Fund ACCTIF.
